text:
The customer service department of HomeTech faces two primary operational bottlenecks: the lack of integration between software systems, which causes repeated data entry and delays due to platform switching, and the absence of a centralized knowledge base, leading to inconsistent information provided to customers. To improve efficiency, HomeTech should implement an integrated customer relationship management (CRM) system to streamline data entry and create a centralized knowledge base to ensure consistent and accurate responses.

The organ that pumps blood is the heart.
